Overview

This feature service provides zoning information for the District of Peachland in British Columbia. It contains polygon-based zoning features that identify land use designations across the community and supports planning, land management, and public reference workflows.

Feature Layer

  • Peachland Zoning: Represents zoning areas for The District of Peachland and includes the current zoning designation for each mapped area.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers The District of Peachland in British Columbia within the Regional District of Central Okanagan.

Use Cases

  • Reviewing zoning designations for parcels and neighborhoods
  • Supporting municipal and regional planning applications
  • Informing land use interpretation and development review
  • Providing open data access to local zoning boundaries

Access and Licensing

Owned by The Distrcit of Peachland, published by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License and related terms of use.
